//: SHIPPED DEFAULTS. Compiled into the binary; never written to at runtime. User settings live in config/silver.json or ~/.config/silver_gallery/silver.json.

viewer.//zoomMode: auto | lock | width | height | fit | fill. Cycled with Z.
viewer.//thumbnailMemoryMegabytes: Viewer-only GPU budget; gallery keeps thumbnails.maxResidentMegabytes.

rendering.//colorManagement: Convert images carrying an embedded ICC profile to sRGB on load. Off shows their raw numbers, which is wrong for Display P3 and Adobe RGB photos.

keys.//: GLFW reports physical key POSITIONS, so compositor-level remaps (XKB caps:swapescape, Hyprland kb_options) are invisible to this app. Enable this if your Caps Lock position sends Escape.
keys.//escapeRepeat: false = one Escape press dismisses one thing; true = holding Escape cascades

icons.//: Lucide icon weight. 1.0 = upstream 2px stroke; raise for heavier icons.

display.//: Rendering quality. DPI is detected automatically from the active monitor.

text.//: Text rendering. hinting: light (GTK/Qt-style, crispest for UI) | normal | none | mono.
text.//pixelSize: Interface text size in points; the whole UI scales with it.

gif.//: Animated GIF playback and decode caps.

animation.//layoutMargin: How far beyond the viewport (points) tiles still animate during a reflow.
animation.//maxVisibleLayoutTravel: Long reflows snap instead of sending tiles across the viewport.
animation.//model: spring = second-order physics, exponential = plain smoothing
animation.//spring: f = natural frequency (Hz), z = damping ratio (1.0 critically damped, <1 bouncy), r = initial response (>0 anticipates, <0 winds up)

thumbnails.//: Tiers the grid decodes at; the smallest one covering the cell wins.
thumbnails.//masterTier: One cached image per photo at this size; every smaller size is derived from it. 0 = largest tier.
thumbnails.//maxResidentMegabytes: GPU memory budget for thumbnails. Counting textures instead of bytes meant this scaled with the zoom tier.
thumbnails.//useSharedCache: read thumbnails already generated by the file manager (~/.cache/thumbnails)
thumbnails.//previewMaxEdge: 0 keeps full source resolution for a pixel-perfect fullscreen viewer; set a pixel cap to reduce memory use.

theme.//name: Active UI theme. Built in: material-expressive, classic-slate.
theme.name: material-expressive
theme.//overrides: Any token of the active theme can be overridden. Colours take #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. Shape tiers and spring values take numbers. Omit what you do not want to change.

hotkeys.//: Viewer keyboard shortcuts. Written the way people write them: Ctrl+K, Shift+Delete, F5, Space. Change one here and it takes effect on restart.

slideshow.//intervalSeconds: Seconds each photo is shown. F5 starts and stops; Space pauses.
slideshow.//randomInterval: Vary the delay between randomMinSeconds and randomMaxSeconds so the pacing is not metronomic.
slideshow.//shuffle: Pick the next photo at random instead of walking the folder in order.
slideshow.//fullscreen: Enter fullscreen automatically when a slideshow starts.

library.//sortBy: Order photos are listed in: taken | modified | name | size | random.
library.//sortAscending: false puts newest/largest first, which is what a photo library usually wants.
